commands.subtitle: SM4 加密/解密
commands.description: SM4 加密工具，支持 ECB/CBC 模式，支持 Hex/Base64/UTF-8 格式

commands.name: aes
commands.title: AES 加密
commands.subtitle: AES 加密/解密
commands.description: AES 加密工具，支持 CBC/GCM/ECB 模式，密钥长度自动推定（AES-128/192/256）

commands.name: rsa
commands.title: RSA
commands.subtitle: RSA 加解密 / 签名验签 / 生成密钥对
commands.description: RSA 工具，支持 OAEP 与 PKCS#1 v1.5 填充、签名验签、生成密钥对

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
